# gronka

> {{ site.description }}

gronka is a Discord bot. It downloads videos and images from social media links and
converts video or image files into GIFs, posting the result back into the channel it was
invoked from. It is free, open source (MIT), and can be self-hosted with Docker. Server
admins can enable or disable each download source individually from a built-in web
dashboard.

Invite link: {{ site.discord_invite }}
Source: https://github.com/thedorekaczynski/gronka

## Commands
{% for command in site.data.commands %}
- [/{{ command.name }}]({{ site.url }}/commands/{{ command.name }}/): {{ command.description }}. Usage: `{{ command.usage }}`
{%- endfor %}

## Notes

- Every command is also reachable from Discord's right-click message context menu.
- `/download` supports 20+ sources, including Twitter/X, TikTok, Instagram, Reddit,
  YouTube, Twitch clips, Bluesky, Facebook, Snapchat, Tumblr, Kick, Rumble, Bilibili,
  Dailymotion, Streamable, Imgur, SoundCloud, Coub, Newgrounds and Xiaohongshu.
- Media is processed with cobalt, yt-dlp, ffmpeg, gifsicle and ImageMagick.
- Files too large to attach to a Discord message are hosted and returned as a link.
